test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Geography is taught to us by Mr. Anand.

options.text: Mr. Anand will be teaching us Geography.
Mr. Anand will teach us Geography.
Mr. Anand shall teach us Geography.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: **Object + is/am/are + past participle + by + Subject.**
 
• Given passive voice sentence: *"Geography is taught to us by Mr. Anand."*
 
• To convert to active voice, move the subject "Mr. Anand" to the beginning.
 
• Change the verb "is taught" to its present simple form "teaches."
 
• Keep the object "us" and the subject "Geography" in their respective places.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mr. Anand teaches us Geography."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Mr. Anand will be teaching us Geography." – Incorrect because it changes the tense to future continuous.
 
• **Option 2:** "Mr. Anand will teach us Geography." – Incorrect because it changes the tense to future simple.
 
• **Option 4:** "Mr. Anand shall teach us Geography." – Incorrect because "shall" is used formally or legally, which is unnecessary here.
